name: Captcha Kit 验证码助手
description: 识别并操作验证码：字符 OCR / 滑块缺口（本地 ddddocr）+ 点选类（视觉模型看图给坐标），操作层覆盖工作面板浏览器（CDP 截图表/拖拽/点击/填写）与 macOS 桌面（screencapture + Quartz 键鼠）。仅限自有或已授权环境。
author: guanwenbo

agentTools.name: captcha_env
agentTools.description: Check or install the local captcha recognition runtime (private Python venv with ddddocr). action=check|setup; setup runs pip in background, poll check until ready.

index.description: Optional pip index URL for setup.

agentTools.name: captcha_recognize
agentTools.description: Recognize a captcha image: type=text (ddddocr OCR), type=slide (match/comparison gap detection), type=click (attaches original + coordinate-grid images for the vision model to output ordered click points).

agentTools.name: captcha_slide_track
agentTools.description: Generate a human-like slider drag trajectory (relative offsets with ease-out, overshoot and jitter).

agentTools.name: captcha_browser
agentTools.description: Work-panel browser captcha operations via host CDP: capture (element image + coordinate mapping), drag (along track), click, fill. Coordinates are page CSS pixels.

agentTools.name: captcha_desktop
agentTools.description: macOS desktop captcha channel: screenshot (screencapture + pixel→point mapping), click / drag / type via Quartz. Windows desktop should use the computer-use plugin instead.

en.name: Captcha Kit
en.description: Recognize and operate captchas on sites you own or are authorized to test: text OCR and slider-gap detection run locally via ddddocr; click-type captchas are answered by the session vision model using an attached coordinate grid. Operation covers the work-panel browser (CDP capture/drag/click/fill) and the macOS desktop (screencapture + Quartz input).
en.safetyNotes: AUTHORIZED USE ONLY — the skill refuses third-party anti-bot bypass. setup spawns pip in a background process and downloads ddddocr/onnxruntime/pyobjc from a pip mirror (default Tsinghua TUNA, overridable) into ~/.pi-desktop/captcha-kit/venv; nothing is installed system-wide. High-risk tools can move the mouse, click, drag and type (macOS Quartz needs Accessibility permission; screencapture needs Screen Recording), and dispatch CDP input to the work-panel browser. Captcha images are processed locally and attached only to the current agent conversation; no upload to third parties. Retries are capped at 3 by the skill.

zh-CN.name: Captcha Kit 验证码助手
zh-CN.description: 识别并操作验证码（仅限自有或已授权环境）：字符 OCR 与滑块缺口检测走本地 ddddocr；点选类回传原图+坐标网格由会话视觉模型给出点击顺序。操作层覆盖工作面板浏览器（CDP 截图/拖拽/点击/填写）与 macOS 桌面（screencapture + Quartz 键鼠）。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅限授权用途——技能明确拒绝第三方站点反爬绕过。setup 会后台拉起 pip，从镜像源（默认清华 TUNA，可改）下载 ddddocr/onnxruntime/pyobjc 到 ~/.pi-desktop/captcha-kit/venv，不污染系统环境。高风险工具可移动鼠标、点击、拖拽、键入（macOS 需辅助功能与屏幕录制权限），并向工作面板浏览器派发 CDP 输入事件。验证码图片仅本地处理并附加到当前会话，不上传第三方。技能规定失败重试上限 3 次。

changelog: 0.1.0 — 首版：captcha_env（venv 自检/后台安装）、captcha_recognize（text/slide/click 三型）、captcha_slide_track（类人轨迹）、captcha_browser（CDP capture/drag/click/fill）、captcha_desktop（macOS screencapture+Quartz）；附双通道编排技能与授权前置。
safetyNotes: 仅限自有或已授权环境。后台 pip 安装私有 venv；高风险工具可控制键鼠（macOS Quartz）与浏览器 CDP 输入；图片仅本地处理并回传当前会话，不上传第三方；重试上限 3 次。
